name: OpenCode TPS
description: Shows how fast an agent is generating in Orca's status bar: tokens per second for the turn that just finished, or a live estimate while OpenCode writes. Follows whichever of OpenCode and pi was active last.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Tokens per second, from OpenCode or pi

settings.title: OpenCode database
settings.description: Path to opencode.db. Leave empty for ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db (or $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/opencode.db).

settings.title: pi sessions folder
settings.description: Folder pi writes its session files to. Leave empty for ~/.pi/agent/sessions.
